scope: Batch catalog and lifecycle evaluation for up to 10,000 public structured-note term sheets.

lifecycle_rules.current_date: Evaluation timestamp supplied by the run, never inferred from document text.
lifecycle_rules.active: issue_date <= as_of_date < maturity_date and no verified autocall event
lifecycle_rules.matured: as_of_date >= maturity_date and verified maturity outcome exists
lifecycle_rules.maturity_pending: as_of_date >= maturity_date and verified maturity outcome is absent
lifecycle_rules.unknown: Required dates or lifecycle evidence are missing or inconsistent
lifecycle_rules.days_to_maturity: max(0, maturity_date - as_of_date) for valid dates

evaluation_contract.current_date_view: Compare each active product's latest permitted market snapshot to its contractual triggers without lookahead.
evaluation_contract.completion_view: At maturity or autocall, compare verified lifecycle outcome to contractual redemption formula.
not_allowed: Infer realized outcome from current price alone.
Use future prices for an earlier as_of_date.
Treat a term sheet as a settled-note label.
Mix document terms, market snapshots and realized outcomes without lineage.

batch_pipeline: Discover official candidates with source and query lineage.
Download with rate limits and retries.
Hash and deduplicate document content and versions.
Parse deterministic fields first; use AI only for bounded extraction review.
Run date, unit, barrier and formula validation.
Join as-of market snapshots using no-lookahead controls.
Attach verified lifecycle outcomes only where independently sourced.
Only then prepare a separate OOS/model-impact experiment.

model_impact.expected_use: Structural coverage, scenario generation and product-universe monitoring.

committee_review.baseline: 1,000 public candidates catalogued; lifecycle join not implemented
committee_review.target: Evaluate each validated product at a supplied as-of date and at maturity without lookahead
committee_review.observed_metric: SEC search totals show at least 926 exact Autocallable Phoenix hits and 941 Phoenix Securities hits; broader queries are capped at 10,000+ and require relevance filtering
blockers: Relevance and duplicate rates for broader SEC queries are unknown.
Lifecycle edge cases require validation against verified outcomes.
No-lookahead market snapshots and contractual terms must remain separate from labels.
acceptance_tests: Lifecycle states transition correctly on synthetic and verified dated fixtures.
No-lookahead checks reject future market observations.
Document hash and term deduplication are reproducible.
Matured/autocalled products have verified outcome linkage before model evaluation.
committee_review.next_experiment: Test lifecycle evaluation on a manually validated 1,000-record subset before scaling to 10,000.
committee_review.final_devin_validation: Lifecycle schema created; no model integration or production mutation performed.
